title: IM Motors.
subtitle: Bringing IM5, IM6 and LS7 to launch.
description: Working with Al Mansour Automotive in Egypt, NMESIS created the launch campaign for IM5, IM6 and LS7, supported by interactive brochures and infographic animations. Explore the campaign film, teaser and production breakdown, then take a closer look at the technology and the three vehicles.

cinematicDescription: From the first glimpse to the full reveal. Explore the IM launch campaign, its teaser and a look behind the production.
infographicDescription: A closer look at the details that shape the drive, from IM5 aerodynamics, lighting and range to the comfort and cabin experience of LS7.
experienceDescription: Explore IM5, IM6 and LS7. Switch between models to discover their details in an interactive experience.
